bounded_sample.method: first 5000 JSONL records of the canonical parent, diagnostic smoke only

semantic_contract.input_legality: own remaining hand plus public play/bid state and only legally visible skat/ouvert information
semantic_contract.target: historical played card stored separately from observation input
semantic_contract.point_semantics: public completed-trick totals; pickup declarer additionally sees points in its own buried cards, matching current deployed bridge semantics
semantic_contract.auction_maxima: derived from explicit bidding actions only

authority.historical_cardplay_policy: candidate auxiliary information only until a bounded causal treatment demonstrates value

next_science_step: Use this reconstruction path for bounded held-out diagnostics and teacher/weakness experiments; do not materialize the full historical cardplay corpus or train from it until the treatment and evaluation design justify the compute.
